    About this brief

    Compiled by UpperCloud Studio for the Arden Fair UnchARTed program. Each entry is graded on a four-axis fit score — style, scale, audience, availability — and accompanied by two visual references from the artist's recent portfolio.

    Field Brief · No. 014 · Cycle 2026

    How to use this

    Filter by tier or medium to narrow shortlists. Each card links out to the artist's primary portfolio. The directory is self-contained — open offline, print, or share the file.

    Visual references regenerated by the /refresh pipeline. Real photos populate as the daily scrape resolves them.
